newsitem.title: GERMANY: LIFFE rules out DTB merger, collaboration possible.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE rules out DTB merger, collaboration possible.

text.p: The head of the London International Financial Futures Exchange (LIFFE) said on Wednesday that he would not rule out a collaboration with Germany's DTB futures and options exchange, but ruled out an outright merger at present.
Daniel Hodson, LIFFE's chief executive, told a conference that he did not belive a merger between LIFFE and the DTB would satisfy the requirements of market participants at present.
"I don't rule out friendly conversations with the DTB in the future and I don't rule out collaboration," Hodson said.
Hodson said that a merger between two large options exchanges would only work if market participants wanted that to take place.
"I don't think they (market participants) see that at the moment, possibly because they themselves benefit from the competition between DTB and LIFFE," he said.
Hodson said competition in the market gave variety and diversity and new ideas.

Werner Seifert, chief executive of the German stock exchange and manager of the DTB had earlier suggested that LIFFE and the DTB should consider closer cooperation in view of changing competitive conditions.
